announced on Friday that its August AUM rose to $1.90T, up from $1.87T a month earlier.
The increase came despite $7.9B in net outflows during the month, with market movements and asset growth helping lift total AUM.
Equity assets rose to $910B from $896B in July, while multi-asset assets increased to $699B from $687B.
Moreover, the fixed-income assets, including money market assets, also edged higher to $225B from $222B, while alternatives reached $63B.
Target-date retirement portfolio assets followed the broader increase, climbing to $631B from $620B in July.

title: T. Rowe Price AUM hits $1.90T despite $7.9B in August outflows
